name: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Fathers

locations.note: Novelist Gabriel Knight investigates voodoo-linked murders in his home town of New Orleans.
Gabriel visits his family's ancestral castle, Schloss Ritter, in the German town of Rittersburg.
Gabriel follows the stolen Ritter talisman to a snake burial mound in Africa, where he finds his great-uncle Wolfgang, who gives his life to win it back.
Jackson Square is where Gabriel sketches the voodoo murder pattern and meets the mime and the street artist.
Gabriel returns to the cathedral several times, and at the end its confessional hides the passage down to the voodoo cult's hounfour, where he rescues Grace and faces Malia.
Marie Laveau's tomb in St. Louis Cemetery No. 1 carries the chalked messages Gabriel decodes.
Professor Hartridge at Tulane University helps with the voodoo research.
Gabriel drinks and asks around at the Napoleon House.
The night-time voodoo rites are hidden out at Bayou St. John.
The Historic Voodoo Museum is where Gabriel starts his research and meets Dr. John.
On the first day Gabriel tags along with Mosely to the lakeshore where a voodoo murder victim was found, copies the pattern drawn in the sand and picks up a snake scale.

routes.name: Gabriel Knight
routes.note: From the French Quarter's voodoo murders and a crime scene on the lakeshore out to a masked rite on the bayou, then to the Ritter family castle in Germany and a snake mound in Africa, before returning to descend through the cathedral into the hidden hounfour.
